correctness.rationale: The seven nonzero ternary detection words factor exactly by the Markov law, with u=psi*pi and r=psi*(1-pi)*a. Ratios recover b from 11* relative to 1**, a from 101 relative to 10*, then psi and pi; all divisions are positive in the open domain. Exactly three independent equality constraints and the open inverse bounds characterize every strictly positive eight-cell law, with necessity and sufficiency by substitution. Two visits admit psi(alpha)=u+r/alpha and pi(alpha)=u/psi(alpha) on an open interval, so failure of identification applies to every interior model. Exact Fraction checker reproduced expansion and inversion for 625 rational parameter tuples and the analytic alias example.

originality.rationale: The primary correlated-replicate occupancy articles introduce Markov likelihoods, modeling choices and simulation diagnostics, but their material inspected does not give the precise nonstationary-initial three-word-law feasibility equations, global inverse or an all-interior two-occasion alias family. The closest general mixture-of-Markov-chains statement requires four waves for a generic two-component model, not a sharp three-wave result for one all-zero component. The searched published finding records cover different objects. The 2010 pragmatic advice to retain at least three segments overlaps the numerical guideline but neither states the present iff theorem nor proves sharpness. Inaccessibility of the full Browning--Carro proof is a named residual risk, not a basis for asserting universal priority.
residual_risks: Full proof of Browning and Carro (2013) unavailable, so a previously observed three-wave structural-zero special case cannot be ruled out.
Related likelihood-based ecological papers may implicitly contain the inverse formulas without explicitly stating the structural threshold; a title/abstract search cannot certify absence.
No claim of priority over unpublished or unindexed work.

value.rationale: Directly answers a natural sampling-design question in the established correlated-replicate ecological occupancy setting: how many ordered binary opportunities suffice to separate absence from Markov-dependent nondetection without presuming equilibrium on the first visit. The complete exact observable-law criterion provides a falsifiable model restriction, not simply a numerical parameter example. Two-visit aliasing changes estimated occupancy in a concrete valid construction, so insufficient replication has a scientifically material identifiability cost; the theorem does not promise finite-sample estimation precision.
